Subject: Your aircraft lease repossession matter

Dear Ms. Bhatt,

Thank you for meeting us on 18 July 2020 about your dispute with Vindhya Aviation Ltd. As we understand it, the airline sought protection from its creditors. The matter is listed before the Gujarat High Court.

Our advice is to argue that leased aircraft fall outside the insolvency moratorium. Please collect the lease agreement and the moratorium order and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs 1,35,46,00,000.

Regards,
Adv. Sharmila Venkatesan
